articles.title: MMA Announces Federal OCS Reef in Place Program
articles.description: 'Eligible offshore structures can continue to serve our coastal communities as artificial reefs', Acting MMA Director Mike Olsen said.

articles.title: EU Joins Call to Raise Global Electrification to 35 Percent by 2035
articles.description: The European Union confirmed endorsement of the '35-by-35 Global Electrification Pledge' at COP31 in Antalya, while major oil exporting countries push back.

articles.title: Trump Calls Venezuela an 'Acquisition'
articles.description: President Donald Trump referred to Venezuela as an 'acquisition' while touting an increasing supply of U.S. energy he said will benefit American allies.

articles.title: Shell Increases Gas Production offshore Malaysia
articles.description: 'Rosmari-Marjoram contributes to Shell's commitment to deliver upstream and integrated gas projects coming onstream between 2025 to 2030 with a total peak production of more than 1.4 million barrels of oil equivalent per day'.

articles.title: Iran Conflict Reshapes Global LNG Trade
articles.description: The U.S. is set to benefit the most as the Iran conflict reshapes the global LNG trade, GlobalData said.

articles.title: Woodside Bags 10-Year Deal to Supply LNG to Trafigura
articles.description: The Singapore-based commodities trader agreed to buy one million metric tons per annum of liquefied natural gas for up to 10 years from Australia's Woodside.

articles.title: Saipem wins $181m drilling contracts for Scarabeo 9 rig
articles.description: Saipem has secured two offshore drilling contracts worth approximately $181m for its Scarabeo 9 semi-submersible in Egypt and Suriname, with work due to start in 2027.

articles.title: EnQuest Exits UK, Pivots to SE Asia
articles.description: EnQuest agreed to divest its British business, which produced over 31,000 barrels of oil equivalent a day last year, to a TotalEnergies-led consortium for up to $960 million.

articles.title: Agency Reports Suggest Oil Market Approaching Turning Point
articles.description: The November reports from the IEA, OPEC, and EIA suggest that the oil market is approaching a turning point, Standard Chartered Bank said.

articles.title: Iran War Set to Hike 2027 UK Energy Bills to Four-Year High
articles.description: The UK’s household energy bills are set to jump by another 26% from January 2027, to the highest since 2023, as the Iran war keeps pushing up wholesale gas and electricity prices, energy consultancy Cornwall Insight said on Wednesday. Currently, the UK energy bills are at their three-year high, as higher gas prices due to the Iran war prompted energy regulator Ofgem to raise the energy price cap on household costs by 4% for October through December. The UK has a so-called Energy Price Cap in place, which protects households…

articles.title: US Oil Inventories On the Rise
articles.description: Crude oil inventories in the United States saw an increase of 3.4 million barrels during the week ending November 13, according to new data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) released on Wednesday. The increase brings commercial stockpiles to 417.8 million barrels, according to government data, which is now 3% below the five-year average for this time of year. Total commercial petroleum inventories increased by 9.2 million barrels during the reporting period. The EIA’s data release follows API’s figures that were…

articles.title: China Gas Upsizes Long-Term LNG Supply with U.S. Venture Global
articles.description: China Gas Holdings Limited, a major Chinese natural gas distributor and operator, has doubled the LNG volumes it will receive from U.S. exporter Venture Global under a recent 20-year deal. China Gas and Venture Global on Wednesday announced the execution of an increased Sales and Purchase Agreement (SPA) for the total purchase of 1.0 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) of U.S. LNG from Venture Global for 20 years starting in 2030. This agreement upsizes the previous SPA announced in September 2026 for the purchase of 0.5 MTPA by another newly agreed…

articles.title: Aker Solutions secures LoI for Statfjord A topside recycling
articles.description: Aker Solutions has obtained a letter of intent (LoI) from Allseas to receive, dismantle, and recycle the Statfjord A platform topside in the North Sea.

articles.title: Nextchem agrees to buy Chart’s LNG technologies for $220m
articles.description: Nextchem, a subsidiary of MAIRE, has agreed to acquire mid-scale and small-scale liquefied natural gas (LNG) process technologies from Chart Industries, a subsidiary of Baker Hughes, for $220m in cash.

articles.title: Mozambique Approves Amended Plan for Rovuma LNG
articles.description: Mozambique's Cabinet approved an amended plan that involves modular, electrified production units.

articles.title: U.S.-Iran Conflict Flares Again as Gulf Nations Brace for Attacks
articles.description: US and Iranian forces exchanged tit-for-tat air strikes in the Middle East, while Gulf nations issued fresh warnings to residents amid threats of incoming projectiles as the currently low-level conflict continued to brew despite the efforts of regional mediators. US officials told news agencies on November 17 that American forces had struck Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz after Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said it had launched an attack on a US military site in Bahrain. AFP quoted an unnamed US official as saying…

articles.title: SBM Offshore wins FPSO contracts from ExxonMobil for Longtail project
articles.description: SBM Offshore has won contracts from ExxonMobil Guyana, a subsidiary of ExxonMobil, to build and install a floating production, storage and offloading vessel (FPSO) for the Longtail development project offshore Guyana.

articles.title: Fracking Giants Tapped to Drill Gas Project in Western Australia
articles.description: Perth-based Black Mountain Energy has selected fracking services giants to drill initial appraisal wells in one of the biggest unconventional gas basins in Western Australia. Black Mountain Energy on Wednesday said it had tendered and selected the major service companies that will play a major role in drilling the initial appraisal wells in Project Valhalla, which the firm says is one of the largest undeveloped gas reservoirs in the world. Black Mountain Energy tapped Helmerich and Payne (H&P) for drilling, Liberty Energy for stimulation and…

articles.title: EnQuest Exits UK North Sea in $960 Million Deal
articles.description: EnQuest has agreed to sell its UK upstream business and associated infrastructure to NEO NEXT+ in a deal worth up to $960 million as the consolidation drive in the UK North Sea continues. The sale price agreed with NEO NEXT+, in which French supermajor TotalEnergies holds 47.5%, envisages $840 million in upfront cash consideration to be paid on completion, and up to $120 million in contingent cash consideration, depending on the price of oil and potential changes in the UK’s Energy Profits Levy (EPL). The proposed sale will include…

articles.title: Small Vessel Trade Thrives in Hormuz as Iran Targets Supertankers
articles.description: Smaller oil tankers moved in October the most volumes of crude oil out of the Strait of Hormuz since the war began, as Iran targets supertankers and incidents with naval mines and unknown projectiles hit a wartime high. The smaller tankers, which can carry less than half the volumes of a supertanker, shipped 2 million barrels per day (bpd) out of the Strait of Hormuz in October, the highest daily volumes since the war began in February, according to Vortexa data cited by Bloomberg. The shipments on Suezmaxes and Aframaxes, mostly via ship-to-ship…

articles.title: ADNOC Ship Attacked in Hormuz as Maritime Security Risks Rise
articles.description: ADNOC Logistics & Services, a unit of Abu Dhabi’s national oil company ADNOC, confirmed on Wednesday that one of its vessels was attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on the evening of November 17, as attacks on tankers in the area have intensified in recent weeks. Following the attack on the ADNOC ship, one crew member remains unaccounted for as of early Wednesday, while all other crew members have been safely evacuated from the vessel. Eleven sustained injuries and, where required, are receiving medical care, ADNOC Logistics…

articles.title: EU Moves to Fast-Track Renewables as Oil Import Costs Soar
articles.description: The European Parliament has reached a provisional agreement for accelerated permit issuance for new energy projects with a focus on wind, solar, grid upgrades, and storage, Reuters has reported, citing the EU Council. Under the terms of the agreement with the EP, member states of the European Union would be able to fast-track new wind and solar developments by categorizing them as being in the overriding public interest. This is the latest step in the EU’s push to further boost the share of alternative energy sources in its mix and reduce…

articles.title: Western Australia Wins Battle Over Federal Gas Reservation Scheme
articles.description: Western Australia, home to facilities producing 66% of the country’s LNG for export, will not be included in a federal government scheme mandating gas companies to set aside certain volumes for the domestic market to avoid shortages. The state, where Woodside Energy operates the North West Shelf site and Chevron operates the Gorgon and Wheatstone platforms, has its own gas reservation scheme, which has convinced the federal government it does not need to be included, the premier of the state, Roger Cook, said today, as quoted by Reuters.…

articles.title: Oil Prices Drop Despite Escalating U.S.-Iran Conflict
articles.description: Crude oil prices extended their decline today, following the Tuesday release of the American Petroleum Institute oil stock report, which showed a build across crude and fuels. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $92.49 per barrel, with West Texas Intermediate at $84.73 per barrel, both down sharply from a month ago when Brent crude was trading at over $100 per barrel, and WTI was at over $98.
